create_zstd_reader: create a ZstdReader instance to decompress zstd media files from a data folder with configurable workers
build_limited_reader: build a LimitedReader wrapper that constrains byte reads from a file-like object to a maximum size
read_media_record: read a zstd-compressed media record from a file at a given offset with optional length prefix
test_zstd_decompression: test zstd streaming decompression with magicless format across multiple threads
review_zstd_reader_threading: review the ZstdReader threaded file pointer management and thread-local decompressor initialization
